title: Cumulative gains can turn negative
hook: Two stated cases: explore the incremental value of a marginal targeted group.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the incremental value of a marginal targeted group affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Increment, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the incremental value of a marginal targeted group in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
